addCompany.title: Add your Florida company
addCompany.subtitle: Enter your Division of Corporations document number (first character is a letter). We pull public Sunbiz data so you can track annual reports and compliance in one place.
addCompany.lookupHint: Example: L15000063512 - same number you use on the state annual report site.
addCompany.legalNamePlaceholder: e.g. ACME HOLDINGS LLC - exact match helps
addCompany.legalNameHelp: If lookup by document number alone fails (common for older companies), enter the name exactly as shown on Sunbiz.org. We search the registry and verify it matches your document number.
addCompany.raUpsellBody: Many owners switch to our Florida registered agent so notices never get lost. Ask us about $150/year agent service when you are ready.
addCompany.confirmHint: Is this your company? Click below to add it to your dashboard - free of charge.
addCompany.successToast: Your company is now on your dashboard.
addCompany.dataSourceBody: We use the Sunbiz Daily API, which mirrors Florida’s business filing feeds. It works like a who’s-who of recent records - not every historical document number is in the index. If the state shows your company as active but our lookup does not, your number is still valid; the data partner just may not have that row yet.
addCompany.officialVerify: Verify on official Sunbiz (document number search)
addCompany.manualTitle: Can't find it automatically? Add it manually.
addCompany.manualHint: Enter your company name exactly as shown on Sunbiz. We'll add it to your dashboard right away and verify the document number with the state.
addCompany.manualFeeNote: Your company will appear on your dashboard immediately. We will confirm the document number with the state within 1 business day.

wizard.ownAgentConfirmTitle: Are you sure you want to be your own registered agent?
wizard.ownAgentConfirmIntro: Most owners use ours because the responsibilities are real. Before continuing, please review:
wizard.ownAgentConfirmHardship1: You must keep a physical {state} street address on the public record (no P.O. Boxes).
wizard.ownAgentConfirmHardship2: You (or whoever you appoint) must be physically present during normal business hours to receive lawsuits, subpoenas, and tax notices in person.
wizard.ownAgentConfirmHardship3: Your home address - if used - becomes public and is sold to mailing-list vendors.
wizard.ownAgentConfirmHardship4: If your agent moves, gets sick, or quits, you have 30 days to file a Statement of Change with the state or the company can be administratively dissolved.
wizard.ownAgentConfirmHardship5: Missed service of process can result in default judgments against the company without you ever knowing.
wizard.ownAgentConfirmBenefit1: {state} street address provided - no need to expose your home.
wizard.ownAgentConfirmBenefit2: Free for the first year, then $150/yr. Cancel anytime.
wizard.ownAgentConfirmBenefit3: Every legal notice scanned and emailed within hours.
wizard.ownAgentConfirmBenefit4: We update the state automatically if our address ever changes.
wizard.ownAgentConfirmContinue: I understand - let me appoint my own agent
wizard.poBoxRejection: P.O. Boxes are not allowed for registered agents - {state} law requires a physical street address.

wizard.memberManagedDesc: The owners (members) run day-to-day operations. Most common for small LLCs.

wizard.directorSectionBody: Florida requires at least one director on the corporation. Most small businesses use the owner as the sole director.
wizard.officerSectionBody: Florida corporations need a President, Treasurer, and Secretary. One person can hold all three roles - most small businesses do.
wizard.officerSectionTip: Tip: bigger companies often split these into President/CEO, Treasurer/CFO, and Secretary. Banks and the IRS expect these titles.
wizard.titleHelpPresidentBody: Top officer of the corporation - runs day-to-day operations and signs contracts on behalf of the company.
wizard.titleHelpTreasurerBody: Officer responsible for finances - bank accounts, accounting records, and tax filings.
wizard.titleHelpSecretaryBody: Officer responsible for corporate records - meeting minutes, shareholder records, and entity filings.

wizard.issuedSharesHelp: How many shares will actually be distributed to shareholders right now. Must be less than or equal to authorized shares.
wizard.shareholderCountHelp: One shareholder gets 100% by default. More than one and we'll split the shares - you can adjust each amount.

wizard.shareAllocationOk: Allocations look good - {issued} of {issued} issued shares assigned.
wizard.shareAllocationOver: You've assigned {allocated} shares but only {issued} are issued. Adjust until they match.
wizard.shareAllocationUnder: You still need to assign {remaining} more share(s) - current total is {allocated}.
wizard.shareAllocationExceedsAuthorized: Issued shares ({issued}) cannot exceed authorized shares ({authorized}).
wizard.scorpBody: The IRS requires each shareholder's tax ID and consent on Form 2553. We collect them securely here - they are encrypted and only used for the S-Corp election.
wizard.scorpTaxIdHelp: SSN for individuals, or the entity tax ID for trusts, estates, and exempt organizations. Encrypted at rest; only the last 4 digits are stored unencrypted.
wizard.scorpConsentLabel: I consent to the S-Corp election for this corporation.
wizard.scorpAllConsentRequired: Each shareholder must consent to the S-Corp election.
wizard.scorpAllTaxIdsRequired: Each shareholder must provide a tax ID for the S-Corp election.
wizard.scorpMembersBody: The IRS requires each LLC member's tax ID and consent on Form 2553. We collect them securely here - they are encrypted and only used for the S-Corp election.
wizard.scorpMembersEmpty: Add at least one member on the previous step to complete the S-Corp election.
wizard.managerRequired: Manager-managed LLCs require at least one Manager.
wizard.ownershipTotalsBlock: ⚠ Ownership percentages add up to {total}%. They must total 100% before continuing.
wizard.oaUpsellLine: Ownership percentages are collected only when an Operating Agreement is included with your plan. You can add an Operating Agreement on the add-ons step.
wizard.oaMultiUpsellBody: Most states strongly recommend multi-member LLCs document ownership splits, voting, and profit distribution. Banks usually require it to open a business account.
wizard.accountSettingsBlurb: We use the email on your account for state notices and document delivery. You can update it from <link>account settings</link>.
wizard.signNoteFlorida: Type your full name as the authorized representative. Your typed name has the same legal effect as a handwritten signature on this filing.
wizard.titleHelpAMBRBody: A person listed as a member of the LLC who is authorized to sign filings, contracts, and bank documents on the company's behalf. Most member-managed LLCs use this title.
wizard.titleHelpMGRBody: A person designated to run day-to-day operations of a manager-managed LLC. Managers may or may not be members; their authority comes from the operating agreement.
wizard.titleHelpMGRMBody: Both a member and a manager - owns part of the LLC and runs operations. Common for small LLCs whose owners want to remain hands-on.
wizard.titleHelpAPBody: A non-member authorized to sign the Articles on the LLC's behalf (typically the organizer or attorney). Most states require at least one authorized person to execute the filing.
wizard.titleHelpOfficerBody: Day-to-day leadership of the corporation - President, Vice-President, Secretary, Treasurer. Most states let one person hold any or all officer titles.
wizard.titleHelpDirectorBody: Member of the board of directors - sets policy, oversees officers, and acts on behalf of the shareholders. Most states require at least one director.
wizard.titleHelpFooter: Most states require only one signed authorized person/incorporator to file. Listing the full team here is optional but strongly recommended - banks and the IRS will ask for it on day one.
wizard.raHelpBody: A registered agent is the company or person who receives legal mail (lawsuits, state notices, tax letters) on behalf of your business. They must have a physical street address in your filing state and be available during business hours. Your business cannot serve as its own agent.
wizard.raInternalConsent: I authorize {agentName} to act as the Registered Agent for my business. I understand that the agent will sign the registered-agent block on my formation document, accepting the obligations of the position - I do not need to type a signature for the agent.
wizard.raExternalLegalCopy: The agent must consent to acting as your Registered Agent. By typing the agent's name below, you confirm that they are familiar with and accept the obligations of the position. This is a legally binding electronic signature.
wizard.tierUpsellOA: Add an Operating Agreement (${price}) - required to capture ownership percentages.
wizard.pendingDocumentMessage: This document is still being issued by the state or the IRS. We will email you the moment it lands.
wizard.addOnDesc_registered_agent: Year-1 free. In-state physical address provided, legal mail scanned, your home address kept off the public record.
wizard.addOnDesc_operating_agreement_single: State-tailored agreement defining ownership, governance, and succession - required by most banks at account opening.
wizard.addOnDesc_operating_agreement_multi: Custom agreement covering profit allocation, voting rights, capital calls, transfer restrictions, and dispute resolution.
wizard.addOnDesc_domain_com: Secure your online identity. Includes WHOIS privacy and free DNS management.
wizard.addOnDesc_cert_status: We pay the state's certificate fee, request the document, and email it to you the moment it lands.
wizard.addOnDesc_cert_copy: State-certified copy of your filed Articles. We pay the state fee and deliver the certified PDF for banks and lenders.
wizard.addOnDesc_annual_report_managed: We file your annual report on time - every year. Avoid late penalties automatically.
wizard.addOnDesc_s_corp_election: Tax classification change. Pre-fills shareholder consents and provides mail-in instructions to the IRS.
wizard.addOnDesc_compliance_alerts: Year-round deadline tracking - annual reports, license renewals, and sales-tax filings.

checkoutSuccess.bankBody: Most banks ask for your Articles of Organization and Operating Agreement to open an account. Bring a photo ID.

admin.approvedHeadline: Approved by Florida Department of State

admin.fileCompanyDesc: Two-step filing package: upload the Sunbiz cover sheet (HTML preferred - also .htm, .mhtml, or PDF), then merge it with the Articles and download for review. Faxing comes next.
admin.fileCompanyStep1: Upload the Sunbiz cover sheet (.html / .htm / .mhtml preferred, or .pdf).
admin.fileCompanyStep2: Merge cover sheet + Articles and download the package (fax later).
admin.fileCompanyDownloadHint: Downloads the merged PDF only - does not fax yet.
admin.fileCompanyCoverMissingHint: Upload the Sunbiz cover sheet below before it can be downloaded.
admin.fileCompanyCoverMustBePdf: Cover page must be a PDF.
admin.fileCompanyEmailHint: Cover Email Address will be set to {email} ({source}). Prefer .mhtml or .pdf so the barcode is preserved.

einForm.einForeignFileConsent: I authorize LaunchForma to prepare IRS Form SS-4 on my behalf and submit it by fax or mail.
einForm.einForeignIdentityConsent: I consent to LaunchForma verifying my identity and contacting me by phone or email if the IRS requests additional documentation.
einForm.einForeignNotice: The IRS online EIN Assistant requires an SSN or ITIN. As a foreign applicant we'll prepare your SS-4 manually and submit it by phone or fax - typical turnaround is 4–6 business days. The IRS may request additional identity verification.
einForm.einManualForeignCopy: We'll prepare a paper SS-4 and submit it to the IRS by phone or fax. Expect 4–6 business days for the EIN to appear in your dashboard.
einForm.einPanelSecurityNote: Identity numbers are encrypted at rest and only the last 4 digits are ever displayed.
einForm.einPassportHint: Encrypted with AES-256-GCM. Only the last 4 characters are stored unencrypted.
einForm.einPathwayForeignSubtitle: The IRS online tool is unavailable; we'll prepare a paper SS-4 and submit by phone or fax.
einForm.einPathwayUsSubtitle: Filed instantly via the IRS online EIN Assistant - usually delivered within 1 business day.
einForm.einPathwayUsTitle: I have a US SSN, ITIN, or EIN
einForm.einReadyOnlineCopy: We'll file your SS-4 with the IRS online as soon as your formation is approved. Expect your EIN letter in your dashboard within 1 business day.
einForm.einTaxIdHint: Encrypted with AES-256-GCM. Only the last 4 digits are stored unencrypted for support.
einForm.einUsConsent: I authorize LaunchForma to use this Tax ID solely to file IRS Form SS-4 on my behalf and confirm I am the IRS-defined responsible party.

einForm.orderConsent: By paying you authorize this one-time charge. You'll add the responsible-party details right after.
